svg.aria-label: Head-to-head comparison of our best family with the WHAR Arena benchmark models
svg.text: Our best family against every model of the WHAR Arena benchmark (10 datasets, paired, seed 0)
Dot = mean over datasets of (ours − paper model); bar = 95 % t-interval; filled = Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p < 0.05 over the 17 comparisons. Right: datasets won–lost.
ours − paper model, macro-F1 points (right = ours better)
Rank among the 17 paper models on each dataset (1 = above all of them), seed 0
Lost ground: Opportunity (#11-13; the paper's MLP-HAR 74.7) and WISDM (#9-11; DANA 85.5). First places: UTD-MHAD, UCI-HAR, UniMiB, ActRecTut, SAD, Daphnet.
